userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: The parking charge before fees, taxes, and discounts; when a validation covers part of it, the part paid in money (the validation line carries the rest). A paymentType payment line (Part 13 §13.6a).
A per-transaction fee the payment channel adds (an app, a text-to-pay vendor). A paymentType payment line.
A service fee the operator adds (valet, reservation). A paymentType payment line.
Tax on the charge, when itemized. A paymentType payment line.
A reduction other than a validation (a promotion, a negotiated rate): a paymentType payment line with a negative value.
A validation applied to the ticket (Part 20): a paymentType validation line whose value is the amount the validation offset, outside the money collected (Part 13 §13.6a).
An EV charging idle charge (Part 23 §23.5). A paymentType payment line.
An EV charging energy charge (Part 23 §23.5). A paymentType payment line.
